rules.title: Break growth tasks into 20-minute units
rules.body: Divide the things you want to learn, practice, and improve into 20-minute units, and let the growth tasks enter the schedule first instead of stopping in the plan.

rules.title: Do the growth task for 5 minutes first
rules.body: When you know it's important but hard to get started, just do it for 5 minutes without having to prove you can last a full round.

rules.title: Reserve meaningful exploration time
rules.body: Continue to reserve time for exploration that allows you to understand the world, renew your experiences, or form new connections, but give it a clear boundary.

rules.title: Stop unlimited expansion option
rules.body: When a growth decision is clear enough, don't delay actually getting in by continuing to look at more possibilities.

rules.title: Create low-cost expression exercises
rules.body: Choose a low-stakes scenario each week and express a true preference, a disagreement, or a need without waiting until you are fully ready to express it.

rules.title: Practice "Don't Comply, But Don't Tear"
rules.body: Practice expressing disagreements clearly rather than cutting them off coldly: talk about shared goals first, then the parts you disagree with.
